seoTitle: KEA Karnataka ESI Recruitment 2026 (188 Posts) Apply Online for Pharmacist & Nursing Officer
seoDescription: KEA Karnataka ESI Medical Services notification for 188 vacancies of Pharmacist Officer (₹44k-₹83k) & Nursing Officer (₹54k-₹99k). Check eligibility (D.Pharm/GNM/B.Sc Nursing), age (18-45 yrs), syllabus & apply by 30 Aug 2026.

title: KEA Karnataka ESI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 188 Posts of Pharmacist Officer & Nursing Officer (Shushrushadhikari) | Salary up to ₹99,400
board: Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA) / ESI Medical Services Department
overview: Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA), Bengaluru on behalf of the Department of ESI Medical Services, Government of Karnataka invites Online Recruitment Applications for direct recruitment of 188 Group 'C' posts of Pharmacist Officer and Nursing Officer (Shushrushadhikari) under Residual Parent Cadre (RPC) Notification No. ED/KEA/34/RECT/2026.

The total 188 vacancies include 98 Posts of Pharmacist Officer (Pay Scale Rs. 44,425 - 83,700) and 90 Posts of Nursing Officer (Pay Scale Rs. 54,175 - 99,400). Selected candidates will undergo a 2-year probation period in ESI Hospitals across Karnataka.

Candidates holding Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) or Diploma in General Nursing (GNM) / B.Sc Nursing with valid registration in Karnataka Pharmacy/Nursing Council and aged between 18 to 45 years can apply online on cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/ from 07.08.2026 to 30.08.2026.
Selection will be conducted through a Compulsory Kannada Language Test (150 Marks) followed by a 200 Marks Competitive Exam (Paper 1 GK + Paper 2 Domain Specific) with 0.25 negative marking.

education: Pharmacist Officer (98 Posts): Must possess Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) from an Institution recognized by the Government of Karnataka AND must be registered with Karnataka Pharmacy Council.

Nursing Officer / Shushrushadhikari (90 Posts): Must possess Diploma in General Nursing (GNM) OR B.Sc Nursing issued by an authority authorized by the Government of Karnataka AND must be registered with Karnataka Nursing Council.
Must have passed SSLC / Class 10th with Kannada as first/second language OR pass the Compulsory Kannada Language Examination conducted by KEA (50 marks out of 150).

howToPayFee: Pay online via KEA portal through Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI Payment mode up to 31.08.2026.
Application fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstance.
selectionProcess: Compulsory Kannada Language Examination: 150 Marks (2 Hours). Candidates must score minimum 50 Marks to qualify (exempted if studied Kannada in SSLC/10th).
Competitive Written Exam (Offline OMR or CBT Mode):
- Paper 1: General Knowledge (100 Questions, 100 Marks, 2 Hours Duration).
- Paper 2: Domain Specific Paper (Pharmacist / Nursing, 100 Questions, 100 Marks, 2 Hours Duration).
Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer in Paper 1 & 2.
Minimum Qualifying Score: Candidates must score minimum 35% in Competitive Written Exam to qualify for merit list.
Document Verification (DV): 1:1 Merit Ratio Original Certificate Verification by KEA.

syllabus: Compulsory Kannada Test: SSLC Standard Kannada Grammar, Translation, Vocabulary, Comprehension.

Paper 1 (General Knowledge): Current Affairs, General Science, Indian History, Indian Geography, Indian Constitution, Karnataka History & Geography, Panchayati Raj, Rural Development & Karnataka Economy.
Paper 2 (Domain Specific - Pharmacist): Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Pharmacognosy, Pharmacology, Hospital & Clinical Pharmacy, Drug Store Management, Pharmacy Act & Ethics.

Paper 2 (Domain Specific - Nursing): Anatomy & Physiology, Fundamentals of Nursing, Community Health Nursing, Medical-Surgical Nursing, Pediatric Nursing, Midwifery & Obstetrical Nursing, Mental Health Nursing.
howToApplySteps: Visit official KEA portal at https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/.
Click on 'ESI Medical Services Recruitment 2026 - Online Application'.
Complete initial registration by providing candidate name, email ID, and mobile number.
Fill in the application form carefully with personal details, qualification, category, and council registration number.
Upload recent passport size photograph (white background, 50KB to 200KB) and signature (black ink on white paper, 50KB to 70KB).
Pay application fee online (₹750 for GM/OBC, ₹500 for SC/ST/Cat-1, ₹250 for PwBD) up to 31.08.2026.
Submit application form before 30 August 2026 and download/print the application acknowledgment copy.

Caste & Income Certificate (Form-D for SC/ST, Form-E for Cat-1, Form-F for 2A/2B/3A/3B).
Rural Study Certificate (Form-1 & Form-2) signed by Headmaster & BEO (if claiming Rural Reservation).
Kannada Medium Study Certificate (if claiming Kannada Medium Reservation).
Discharge Certificate / Service Book for Ex-Servicemen.
Aadhaar Card / Government Photo ID Card.
importantInstructions: Online Application Window: 07.08.2026 to 30.08.2026 (Fee Payment up to 31.08.2026).
Candidates must hold active registration with Karnataka Pharmacy Council or Karnataka Nursing Council on or before closing date.
Compulsory Kannada Test score is qualifying only and not added to final competitive merit list.
Negative marking of 0.25 marks applies to all wrong answers in Paper 1 and Paper 2.
KEA Candidate Helpline: 080-23460460 (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM on working days).

faqs.question: What is the total vacancy count in KEA Karnataka ESI Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: There are total 188 vacancies including 98 Posts of Pharmacist Officer and 90 Posts of Nursing Officer (Shushrushadhikari).

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply online for KEA ESI Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The closing date to submit online application is 30 August 2026, and application fee can be paid up to 31 August 2026.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for Pharmacist and Nursing Officer in KEA ESI?
faqs.answer: Pharmacist Officer pay scale is ₹44,425 - ₹83,700 per month, and Nursing Officer (Shushrushadhikari) pay scale is ₹54,175 - ₹99,400 per month.

faqs.question: What is the qualification required for Pharmacist Officer in KEA?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) from a Govt of Karnataka recognized institution AND be registered with the Karnataka Pharmacy Council.

faqs.question: What is the qualification required for Nursing Officer in KEA?
faqs.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in General Nursing (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing from a Govt of Karnataka recognized authority AND be registered with the Karnataka Nursing Council.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in KEA ESI Competitive Written Exam?
faqs.answer: Yes. 0.25 marks (1/4th) will be deducted for every incorrect answer in Paper 1 (GK) and Paper 2 (Domain Specific).
